physics.note: Masses/materials, motor limits, damping and friction are editable estimates; not hardware identification. Gimbal and gas springs removed.

geometry_corrections.reason: User: right thigh motor A distance 101 -> 106 mm; move motor and driving sprocket together

removed_subsystems: entire yaw assembly and head, including feed chain and mount strips
both gas springs, their joints, preload forces and limits
limitations: Material densities and motor mass/torque/damping are estimates, edit physics.json and rerun export.
No balance/gait controller; stand scene fixes floating base for mechanism checks.
Internal wheel gears and motor-side chain/belt pulleys are static equivalent-transmission visuals; actuators command output torques.
Complete bearings assigned to one adjacent body; no internal rolling-element dynamics.
IMU sites are reference frames at body origins, not measured PCB positions.
